verdict.rationale: Synctera's docs describe a dedicated Sandbox environment. API keys issued there can call the APIs immediately (synctera-docs-14), KYB is auto-passed in Sandbox (synctera-docs-35), and sandbox test cases are documented for exercising KYC/KYB flows (synctera-docs-25). missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data is isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.
